easyPrerequisites: Kiora's Follower doesn't have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate City of Traitors by tapping it, adding six {C} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, untapping City of Traitors
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
